business_summary: Niterra Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells spark plugs and related products for internal-combustion engines and technical ceramics in Japan and internationally. The company offers spark plugs, including plugs for aftermarket and original equipment, igniter plugs, and resistor cables and covers; glow plugs comprising ceramic and metal type glow plugs, and glow controllers; and oxygen, NOx, temperature, and knock sensors. It also provides semiconductor packages used in all kinds of products, including smartphones, cameras, and cars, as well as manufacturing parts for semiconductors, and medical products. In addition, the company offers fine ceramics, balls for bearings, piezoelectric ceramics, other industrial ceramics such as plungers for pumps and ceramic protective plates, including wear-resistant parts, ultrasonic transducers and sensors, products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, electric equipment products, and other ceramic products. Further, it provides cutting tools comprising ceramic, micro grain carbide, coated carbide, and cubic boron nitride grades, as well as SS and rotational tools; and sumikaze, a sterilization deodorizer utilizes ozone to purify the air and inhibit invisible harmful substances and viruses. The company sells its spark and glow plugs under the NGK brand; and sensors, semiconductor packages/substrates, cutting tools, oxygen concentrators, and piezoelectric and fine ceramics under the NTK brand. The company was formerly known as NGK Spark Plug Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Niterra Co., Ltd. in April 2023. Niterra Co., Ltd. was founded in 1936 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Niterra Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본 및 해외 내연기관 및 기술 세라믹용 스파크 플러그 및 관련 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 애프터마켓 및 원래 장비용 플러그, 점화 플러그, 저항기 케이블 및 커버를 포함한 스파크 플러그를 제공합니다. 세라믹 및 금속형 글로 플러그를 포함하는 글로 플러그, 글로 컨트롤러; 산소, NOx, 온도 및 노크 센서. 또한, 스마트폰, 카메라, 자동차 등 각종 제품에 사용되는 반도체 패키지는 물론 반도체용 부품, 의료제품 제조도 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 파인 세라믹, 베어링용 볼, 압전 세라믹, 기타 산업용 세라믹(펌프용 플런저, 세라믹 보호판 등), 내마모 부품, 초음파 트랜스듀서 및 센서, 반도체 제조 장비용 제품, 전기 장비 제품, 기타 세라믹 제품도 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 세라믹, 미립자 탄화물, 코팅 탄화물, 입방정 질화붕소 등급으로 구성된 절삭 공구와 SS 및 회전 공구를 제공합니다. 그리고 살균탈취제 스미카제
